glossy orb animation

Web·by @basit_designs·2026-08-28·inspora page·original post

What it is

Product page for 'KOODOR' built around a glossy iridescent orb: the hero orb image shifts hue/angle between frames (pink->red->chrome) as the page scrolls, with bento cards showing the orb at small scale; an ambient hue-rotation and perspective drift.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-30%
Three-column layout: text card, large orb hero card (pink/red glossy sphere with liquid-metal reflections over a teal gradient), spec card with a small orb; orb hue pink-magenta.
30-65%
Orb's internal swirls crawl and its hue rotates toward red/crimson; small orb in spec card mirrors the shift; chrome pill image stays static.
65-100%
Hue continues cycling (pink->red->violet); layout fixed - all motion inside the orb imagery; loop.

Build prompt

Build a glossy-orb product hero. Center card: a liquid-metal orb - CSS-only version: layered radial gradients (hot pink core, crimson mid, near-black rim) plus 2 specular streaks (blurred white ellipses at 20-30%), masked to a circle, over a dark teal vertical gradient. Animate: hue-rotate filter 0->360deg over 10s linear infinite on the orb layer only, plus a slow background-position drift of the swirl layer (20s) so reflections crawl. Pro version: port to a fragment shader - fbm noise domain-warped, mapped through a pearlescent ramp (pink/violet/chrome), time uniform drives swirl. Surround with quiet bento cards (spec text, a small synced orb, a chrome pill render) so the hero owns the motion.

scroll + ambient loop
